jobs.title: Sr. BA II
jobs.description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

**Job Description**
===================

### **Invesco understands data and the products created from data are the lifeblood of our business. Data\-first functions work together seamlessly to enable Invesco to achieve the true value of data and data products. Invesco leverages data as a strategic asset by making quality, trusted data and content available to the right people, at the right time, in the right format, in the most efficient way possible to enable both large transformations and day\-to\-day operations.**

### **This Senior Business Analyst role sits within the Product Engagement part of our Digital, Distribution and Enterprise Engineering (D2E2\) organization. They maintain good relationships with internal partners and collaborate with their peers across the Distribution business domain. They develop a strong understanding of the investments and distribution data and business processes, including both how it is produced and consumed across all Distribution channels and how to apply Invesco’s Data strategy and practices to drive Distribution’s data capabilities forward.**

### **The focus of this position is to work closely with the business units to gain in\-depth understanding of customer's business strategy, processes, services, roadmap and the context in which the business operates. This role will be key to understanding and documenting capabilities needed to address business challenges. Under the general supervision, gather business and data requirements, convert the business and data requirements into technical requirements for solution development. The senior business analyst supports the product owner(s) in managing the scope of the assigned project(s), resolves any impediments from requirements perspective for development team, supports the system testing and user acceptance testing. The business analyst also performs validation of deliverables against requirements ensuring that solution is meeting the objectives.**

### **You will be responsible for:**

* **The Senior Business Analyst is responsible for reviewing assigned business processes from end\-to\-end to identify and address operational, financial and technological risks.**
* **Analyzing and understanding the end\-to\-end Distribution processes and the data associated with multiple business processes having cross domain.**
* **Identify opportunities to improve efficiency.**
* **Responsibilities will include a full range of activities from leading small to mid\-size projects to assisting product owners on larger more complex projects.**
* **Under the guidance of the product owners, the senior business analyst should be able to work with business stakeholders to document the functional and non\-functional requirements.**
* **Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.**
* **Translates conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is understandable to developers/project team.**
* **Demonstrate strong Problem\-solving skills.**
* **Attending regular team and other required meetings daily/weekly.**
* **Ensuring clear and accurate communication and responding to data, business, and technology partners and peers in a timely manner.**
* **Provides updates to senior management, project stakeholders on the progress of the project and or assigned tasks.**
* **Reports weekly status to senior management and project team as applicable**
* **Conduct UAT testing when rolling out new regulatory filings or added data sources**
* **Identify, research, document and / or remediate exceptions**
* **Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.**

### **This individual:**

* ### **Understand the full Distribution business processes and data flows to provide meaningful insights and improvements, including both the Retail and Institutional Asset Management business.**
* ### **Work closely with business teams to gather and document their data needs, identify key data sources, and collaborate with stakeholders and technology teams to resolve data\-related issues.**
* ### **Lead interviews, and discussions to capture the right requirements and ensure alignment.**
* ### **Drive process improvements to boost efficiency and reduce operational risks**
* ### **Use your strong industry knowledge to provide context and insight that enhances decision\-making.**
* ### **Validate how data is consumed across reports, websites, dashboards, and applications, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across all systems.**
* ### **Query Snowflake and other databases efficiently to extract and analyze data.**
* ### **Run APIs as part of data integration and validation processes.**
* ### **Analyze data quality issues, identify exceptions, and recommend remediation strategies.**
* ### **Apply strong analytical skills to interpret data and support business objectives.**
* ### **Translate business requirements into detailed technical instructions that engineering teams can use to build and troubleshoot solutions during development and production.**
* ### **Support Product Owners by helping prioritize and refine the backlog, managing scope, and participating actively in Agile ceremonies.**
* ### **Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to confirm that solutions meet business expectations.**
* ### **Keep stakeholders informed with clear project updates and risk…

Site Reliability Engineer (Application Reliability)
  
  

**ABOUT US:**  

As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
  
  

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  

Site Reliability Engineer (Application Reliability)
  
  

**Location:** Hyderabad
  
  

**Working Hours:** GMT/BST, aligned with London
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are growing our Site Reliability Engineering team with a Senior Officer, Site Reliability Engineer who will help make the applications and services behind our products measurably more reliable. Our SRE team brings together engineers who care about instrumentation, incident response and the health of production systems, all working toward a common mission: giving product and engineering teams the observability, guardrails and operational practices they need to run their services with confidence.
  
  

This role is for an SRE who comes from an application engineering background. You will spend your time close to the code and the telemetry it produces: instrumenting services with OpenTelemetry, building the dashboards, SLOs and alerts that tell us when something is wrong, and digging into application behaviour when it is. Expect to read and debug code in a stack such as .NET, Java, Node.js or Python, follow a request through HTTP, gRPC, queues and databases, and work out where latency, errors or resource exhaustion are actually coming from, then work with the owning team to fix it properly rather than restart it again.
  
  

Our platform runs around the clock and so does the team behind it. On\-call coverage moves naturally across time zones as the day progresses. This position anchors the London (GMT/BST) window of that follow\-the\-sun rotation, and as part of it you should expect to step in on weekends from time to time.
  
  

This is a strong fit for an experienced individual contributor who has built and operated production software, enjoys the discipline of measuring reliability rather than guessing at it, and wants to deepen their expertise in site reliability engineering within a regulated financial services environment.
  
  

On\-Call \& Coverage Expectations
  
  

On\-call is a core, ongoing part of this role and not an occasional add\-on. Please read this section carefully before applying.
  
  

Your standard working hours align with London (GMT/BST) and cover the European business day from our Hyderabad office.
  
You will take part in a shared on\-call rotation with the wider SRE team, following a follow\-the\-sun model in which coverage hands over between regions as each working day ends.
  
While on rotation you are expected to be reachable, to acknowledge and respond to pages within the agreed response targets, and to drive or support incidents through to resolution and handover.
  
Weekend and public holiday coverage is part of the rotation and comes around periodically; you should expect to step in from time to time.
  
Escalation and paging run through PagerDuty. You will help keep escalation policies, schedules and alert routing accurate and low\-noise.
  
After significant incidents you will take part in blameless postmortems and follow through on the resulting action items.
  
What You'll Do
  
  

**Build:** Observability \& Reliability Engineering
  
  

Instrument applications and services with OpenTelemetry (traces, metrics and logs), including SDK\-based and auto\-instrumentation, correct context propagation and sensible attribute and cardinality choices.
  
Build and maintain Grafana dashboards and Prometheus\-based metrics, recording rules and alerts that reflect real user\-facing behaviour rather than raw infrastructure noise.
  
Define and implement SLIs, SLOs and error budgets with product engineering teams, and make burn\-rate alerting the basis of paging where it fits.
  
**Improve alert quality:** remove duplicate and low\-value alerts, tighten thresholds, add runbook links and make sure every page is actionable.
  
Build and maintain PagerDuty integrations, services, escalation policies and schedules so that alerts reach the right people with the right context.
  
Write code and automation (e.g., Python, Go, Bash, or your primary application language) to reduce toil, automate recurring operational tasks and codify observability configuration.
  
Use AI\-assisted tools (e.g., coding assistants, observability and incident copilots) in your own day\-to\-day work and help other developers adopt AI tooling effectively.
  
  

**Operate:** Incident Response \& Production Ownership
  
  

Monitor service health, respond to incidents and take part in our on\-call rotation, including occasional weekend coverage.
  
Act as incident responder and, where needed, incident commander: triage, coordinate responders, communicate status and drive to mitigation.
  
Debug production issues in the application layer, including latency and error\-rate regressions, memory and garbage\-collection pressure, thread and connection pool exhaustion, retry storms, timeouts and cascading failures.

Account Management \& Relationship Building

Deliver executive\-level presentations and effectively handle CXO\-level discussions. \[

Protect existing revenue streams by managing contract renewals and mitigating churn.

Strong commercial acumen with the ability to structure complex, multi\-year financial deals.

 Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
   

  

 Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. * Collaborate with Product Managers across product groups on cross\-cutting initiatives.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Product Manager** 
 to lead the development and evolution of an AI\-native B2B product designed for complex engineering, tendering and document\-intensive business workflows.
 



  





 The successful candidate will combine product\-management capability with practical domain understanding. You will work directly with enterprise users, product designers, business analysts, AI engineers and software\-development teams to identify customer problems, define the roadmap and convert domain workflows into scalable product capabilities.
 



  





**Professional experience in at least one of the following sectors is mandatory:** 



* Water and wastewater infrastructure
* Electrical or modular infrastructure
* Data centres
* Industrial manufacturing



  





 Relevant experience may come from working within these industries, supporting EPC or engineering projects, managing bids and proposals, or developing technology products for these sectors.
 



 This is a product\-ownership role—not solely a project\-coordination position. You will be accountable for what the product should solve, what gets prioritised and the outcomes delivered to customers.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 



* Develop a deep understanding of users, industry workflows and operational challenges within the target sectors.
* Conduct discovery sessions with bid, proposal, estimating, engineering, commercial, contracts and management teams.
* Map complex workflows involving tender review, qualification, compliance, risk, estimating, proposals, approvals and contract handover.
* Define and maintain the product vision, roadmap, priorities and release objectives.
* Translate customer and domain problems into clearly defined product opportunities and use cases.
* Prioritise features based on customer value, domain relevance, market opportunity, technical effort and scalability.
* Distinguish between customer\-specific requests and capabilities that should become part of the core product.
* Work with the Product Business Analyst to define requirements, business rules, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with Product Designers to create intuitive workflows, prototypes and enterprise\-product experiences.
* Partner with AI and engineering teams to assess feasibility, define expected behaviour and make product trade\-offs.
* Define how AI should assist users while maintaining accuracy, transparency, reviewability and human control.
* Manage the product backlog and ensure requirements and priorities are clearly understood by the development team.
* Participate in sprint planning, design reviews, product demonstrations and release\-readiness reviews.
* Engage directly with customers during product demonstrations and pilots.
* Capture structured feedback from pilots and convert validated learning into product improvements.
* Define and track product metrics such as adoption, feature usage, workflow completion, time saved and customer outcomes.
* Conduct market and competitor analysis to strengthen product differentiation.
* Support Product Marketing and Sales with positioning, use cases, demonstrations, launches and sales\-enablement material.
* Ensure product decisions consider enterprise requirements such as security, permissions, auditability, integrations and deployment.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* **Mandatory** 
 professional experience in at least one of these sectors: water and wastewater infrastructure, electrical or modular infrastructure, data centres, or industrial manufacturing.
* 2–5 years of experience in Product Management, preferably involving B2B SaaS, enterprise software or workflow platforms.
* Demonstrated experience taking a software product or major feature from discovery through launch and adoption.
* Understanding of engineering, EPC, tendering, proposal, estimating, commercial or contract\-related workflows.
* Strong capability in customer discovery, problem definition, roadmap planning and feature prioritisation.
* Experience managing complex business workflows and document\-intensive enterprise applications.
* Ability to translate industry problems into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Experience working with product designers, business analysts, engineering, AI and QA teams.
* Strong understanding of agile product\-development practices, backlog management and release planning.
* Experience defining user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, edge cases and product\-success metrics.
* Ability to communicate credibly with domain experts, enterprise customers, senior stakeholders and technical teams.
* Ability to challenge customer requests constructively and protect the long\-term scalability of the product.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* A track record of ownership, independent decision\-making and cross\-functional leadership.



  





 Experience with AI/LLM\-enabled products, document intelligence, knowledge systems or workflow automation would be highly valuable.

 Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Information Technology \& Digital
   

  

 In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
   

  

 Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
   

  

 Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.

 The role ensures clear product vision, roadmap ownership, and strong value delivery, translating Genesis objectives into well‑defined product outcomes aligned to procurement priorities. This includes shaping product strategy, defining success metrics, prioritising backlogs, and ensuring products are delivered in line with agreed objectives, timelines, and governance standards.

This includes contributing to executive forums (e.g. Steering Committee and EOLT) with clear product insights on progress, risks, dependencies, and benefits realization.

 Translate Procurement strategy and pain points into high‑value AI use cases, balancing innovation with practical business impact.
   

  

 Define product success through clear value metrics, KPIs, and adoption measures, ensuring benefits are realised and sustained.
   

  

**AI Product Delivery**
 Lead the end‑to‑end product lifecycle: discovery, POCs, MVPs, scaling, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Shape and prioritise the product backlog, working closely with Product Owners, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, AI Engineers, Business Analysts, and Architects.

 Partner closely with Procurement leaders across GBS to ensure tight business alignment on benefits delivery and adoption.
   

  

 Manage and govern relationships with external partners, ensuring outcomes, delivery quality, and knowledge Innovation and Thought Leadership
   

  

 Stay current with AI trends including LLMs, agent‑based systems, optimisation algorithms, game theory, and decision intelligence, and assess their relevance for Procurement.
   

  

 Champion experimentation and learning, helping the organisation move from proof‑of‑concept to scaled value.
   

  

 Act as an AI evangelist within Procurement, able to simplify complex concepts for non‑technical stakeholders.
   

  

 The experience we're looking for
   

  

**Skills/Experiences**
**Essential**
* 12\+ years of experience as a Product Manager delivering digital or AI driven products.
* Strong Procurement domain knowledge, particularly across the Source to Pay process.
* Solid understanding of AI and analytics concepts, including LLMs, ML models, algorithms, and data pipelines (hands on coding not required).
* Ability to work effectively in complex, matrixed environments with global stakeholders.

**Desirable**

* Familiarity with concepts such as agentic AI, optimisation, simulation, and game theory.
* Experience operating within Agile / product led delivery models.

**Technical / Professional Qualifications:**
**Essential**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Supply Chain, Procurement, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience using product and delivery management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira, Productboard, or similar) to manage backlogs, roadmaps, and delivery flow.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint (executive storytelling), PowerBI (analysis and value tracking), and Word.

**Desired**

jobs.description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Your Career**
 At Palo Alto Networks, we're looking for an experienced engineering leader to build and scale world\-class cloud\-native security products. As a Senior Product Owner, you will be the vital bridge connecting Product Management, R\&D Managers, and our high\-caliber engineering teams. This is not a passive backlog\-grooming role; it is a position for a deeply analytical, systems\-minded product leader. You will sit at the intersection of business strategy and complex technical execution, converting abstract business requirements into precise, scalable engineering deliveries. You will partner with our Software Architects and Senior Staff Engineers, understanding their system integrations while holding Product Management accountable for defining airtight, edge\-case\-proof product requirements.
   

  

**Your Impact**
* The R\&D and Product Bridge: Serve as the primary liaison between Product Management, R\&D Managers, and engineering teams, aligning business timelines with realistic technical capacity.
* Requirement Articulation: Translate high\-level business goals, market needs, and user feedback into deeply detailed, technical user stories and functional specifications that engineers can immediately execute.
* Upstream Challenging \& Edge\-Case Discovery: Act as the first line of defense against vague product requirements. Proactively challenge Product Management to think through hidden edge cases, data dependencies, and system impacts before pushing features to R\&D.
* Systems \& Integration Fluency: Maintain a strong conceptual grasp of our distributed systems, microservices architecture, and complex product integrations to ensure feature requests are technically viable.
* Stakeholder Management \& Commitment: Act as an exceptional communicator who can evangelize the product roadmap, rally cross\-functional teams around requirements, and secure ironclad commitments from all dependencies.
* Quality Review \& Feedback Loop: Review engineering deliverables against acceptance criteria, provide constructive, high\-quality feedback to the development teams, and champion the end\-user experience.


**Qualifications**
**Your Experience**

The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. * Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.

* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.

ScienceLogic is hiring a hands\-on Engineering Manager to lead our Platform Engineering team in Hyderabad. You will report to the Director of Product Engineering (India), with a dotted line to the Sr. Director of Engineering (US), and you'll sit on the India engineering leadership team. You'll provide leadership across platform modernization, reliability, and operational excellence while developing future team leaders and strengthening the team's management structure.

ScienceLogic scored a leadership position in the “Forrester Wave” AI Observability report. We are a global, growing software company reinventing the way companies manage their hybrid cloud data and systems by driving operational and business insights from the extensive data types contained in the SkylarOne data lake with AI.

**What you'll be doing...**


You'll lead a ten\-person team comprised of full\-time employees and contractors, covering the following day\-to\-day:

* Owning technical direction and architecture for SkylarOne platform modernization, including OS migrations, cloud infrastructure, and system reliability.
* Managing delivery across systems engineering, DevOps/test infrastructure, and networking, staying hands\-on with design reviews, troubleshooting, and code/config review while delegating as the team grows.
* Developing future leaders within the organization and building an effective management and technical leadership structure that supports team growth and scale.
* Partnering with the QA Engineering Manager, the Solutions Engineering Manager, and India\-based Product Owners to align platform work with product and quality roadmaps.
* Owning hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development for direct reports.
* Representing the India platform team in planning and reviews with Mahesh Hanumanula and other US engineering leadership.
* Driving infrastructure cost optimization and rightsizing across on\-premises (VMware) and AWS environments.
* Participating in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and driving continuous improvement in system operations and release readiness.

**Qualities you possess...**

**Must have:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 10\+ years of engineering experience, including at least 3 years leading engineering teams. People\-management experience is required for this role, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Demonstrated experience growing a team's structure, hiring into a growing org, and ideally building or mentoring a first layer of team leads.
* A hands\-on background in systems engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering: comfortable reviewing architecture, debugging production issues, and making infrastructure decisions rather than just relaying them.
* Strong understanding of Linux administration, automation, and cloud infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, routing) sufficient to guide a networking specialist on the team.
* Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code practices (e.g., Terraform, Jenkins).
* Comfortable operating across a matrixed reporting structure and collaborating with stakeholders in different time zones.

**Good to have:**

* AWS experience or certification.
* Scripting or programming experience (Python, Golang, or Bash).
* Exposure to AI\-driven development practices or AI coding assistants.
* CCNA/CCNP or equivalent networking certification.
* Experience with distributed systems or large\-scale data processing environments.

*Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At ScienceLogic, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*

 *All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which you are applying.*

jobs.title: IT&D Business Analyst, Quality
jobs.description:
We are Reckitt
   

  

 Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Information Technology \& Digital
   

  

 In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
   

  

 Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
   

  

 Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Quality is a critical part of what we do at Reckitt. The IT\&D team empower Reckitt’s commitment to Quality and the trust our consumers place in our products. We pro\-actively manage processes and tools across our Quality Management/Quality Control products for our \~40,000 colleagues.
   

  

 Strategic Execution: You will partner with key business SMEs to elicit, analyse, document and manage product requirements. You will support the Product Manager and team in realising the product strategy – delivering incremental value to the business, sprint by sprint.
   

  

 Computer Software Assurance: Our Quality solutions are generally subject to GxP requirements. You will work with our Agile delivery team, across our Azure DevOps platform, to deliver CSA\-compliant records and audit\-ready products.
   

  

 Agility: Our Quality solutions stretch from the first seeds of innovation in R\&D through to finished product release in our Quality Control labs. Your agility and communication skills will be key in staying effective against the breadth of solutions we support.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* 
+ Supporting the implementation and business\-as\-usual running of global and local applications such as Veeva QualityOne, LabWare LIMS, Empower CDS and Chromeleon CDS
+ Writing and reviewing validation documentation, e.g. Validation Plans, Validation reports and other necessary GxP documents
+ Working with business users to understand the system requirements, technical issues, and support IT developer/vendor in addressing the needs
+ Working with delivery partners to ensure that any functional designs they are delivering are in line with standardised templates
+ Supporting delivery partners and business users with the testing phase to ensure that system meets requirements


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* Experience working in a Business Analyst role driving requirements and/or design workshops
* Knowledge of GAMP 5 CSV framework and/or CSA ways of working
* Experience working in Waterfall and/or Agile delivery environments
* Experience of supporting complex change and/or multi\-disciplinary projects
* Excellent communication skills
* Experience of working with and influencing business stakeholders to balance business needs with IT\&D standards and processes.
* Enthusiastic about the use of technology, with a proven ability to provide a communication ‘bridge’ between the business and technologists.
* Experience using DevOps and Service Management solutions
* Previous experience of Quality solutions Veeva Quality One, LIMS and CDS are advantageous for a candidate


 The skills for success
   

  

 Quality solutions Veeva Quality One, LabWare LIMS, Empower CDS and Chromeleon CDS
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Crowe's AI Y\-Hire practice moves from foundational skills — requirements support, artifact creation, learning the craft — toward independent ownership of complex engagements. The AI Business Analyst operates at an experienced level, applying established business analysis skills across complex engagements while leveraging AI\-enabled ways of working.
   

  

 At the entry level, a BA supports elicitation, assists with testing, and follows established standards. At this level, you lead elicitation, own testing programs, and extend standards to account for what AI\-augmented delivery requires. This role expands traditional business analysis responsibilities by incorporating AI\-enabled analysis, documentation, and delivery practices. In this role, you will facilitate workshops, synthesize information using AI\-enabled tools, and translate insights into actionable deliverables that support project outcomes.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The AI Business Analyst at Crowe translates business needs into clear, actionable requirements for AI solutions, automation platforms, and development teams. This means applying business analysis fundamentals — elicitation, documentation, testing — through an AI\-first operating model.
   

  

 You will use Gen AI tools including Claude Code as active instruments of analysis: interrogating process mining output to draft automation opportunity backlogs, generating first\-pass test plans from acceptance criteria, and using LLM analysis to surface requirement gaps before they reach development. You will be responsible for delivering high\-quality work products from discovery through user acceptance testing and implementation readiness.
   

  

 Operating from India, you will work in close partnership with US\-based teams across client engagements in process optimization, Hyperautomation, and Gen AI solution delivery.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Discovery \& Analysis**
* Lead structured discovery workshops with client stakeholders — using AI tools in session to capture, synthesize, and reflect back current\-state processes, pain points, and desired outcomes in real time; produce structured outputs before the debrief.
* Conduct process and task mining analysis using Microsoft Process Mining, Celonis, or equivalent platforms to surface high\-ROI automation opportunities; translate event\-log insights into prioritized opportunity backlogs with quantified business impact.
* Analyze UX feedback, job aids, procedures, and existing process maps to identify candidates for further optimization; summarize findings and present recommendations with supporting data.
* Proactively identify, analyze, and resolve requirement risks, gaps, and ambiguities — using LLM\-assisted cross\-reference of documentation to catch inconsistencies before they reach development; partner with stakeholders to resolve issues and appropriately escalate matters when additional guidance or decisions are required.


**Requirements \& Solution Design**
* Elicit and document business, user, functional, and non\-functional requirements with sufficient detail to support effective implementation of AI\-enabled and traditional technology solutions — including decision logic, tool invocations, exception handling, and appropriate human review and oversight checkpoints.
* Translate requirements into the full artifact set: user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, wireframes, data models, swimlane diagrams, and state diagrams — using AI\-assisted tooling to accelerate first\-draft creation and human judgment to validate and refine.
* Design Target Operating Models that show how people, AI agents, and automated processes interact in the future state — including role evolution, governance guardrails, and escalation paths that keep humans accountable for outcomes.
* Use AI coding and analysis assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot Cowork) as a productivity layer: generate first drafts of plans, criteria, models, and documentation; ensure all deliverables meet quality, accuracy, and business requirements.


**Delivery \& Backlog Management**
* Own requirements traceability end\-to\-end and maintain alignment between business requirements, solution design, testing activities, and expected business outcomes; maintain documentation throughout the project lifecycle to reflect evolving business needs and decisions.
* Lead backlog organization, refinement, and work item maintenance using Crowe\-standard Agile tooling (Azure DevOps or equivalent) — ensuring stories are sprint\-ready, acceptance criteria are complete, and the backlog reflects current business priorities at all times.
* Build and execute structured testing programs — functional, integration, regression, performance, and usability — for Gen AI solutions from first prototype through production handoff; prepare test plans and scripts with enough specificity that a QA engineer can execute them without clarification.
* Facilitate and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT): coordinate test cycles with client teams, manage defect triage, and own sign\-off on solution readiness.

jobs.description:

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Basel III Business Analyst – Manager/Senior**
**Description**
 EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.
   

  

 Within EY’s Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
   

  

 Within FSRM, the CSTC team assists across end\-to\-end aspects of Capital management, BASEL, credit risk and Stress testing related activities:
   

  

* Key role involves producing critical deliverables to the senior management and regulators including EMEIA, US and APAC entities’ credit risk review, capital projections, Basel 4, Basel 3 endgame, capital aspects of Recovery \& Resolution planning (RRP), stress testing and having oversight of various regulatory requirements.
* Consulting and solutions delivery such as impact assessments, defining the target operating model, and integrated risk and finance reporting framework
* Quality assurance such as assessment of controls of the Banking industry and similar business lines covering regulatory reporting involving Basel/CRR/RRP regulations
* Early identification and accurate analysis of prudential developments and influence on changes to the capital framework.
* Regulatory capital impact assessment in legal entity simplification initiatives, business re\-organizations, new business initiatives and external commitments to regulators


 Clients include large domestic and global financial institutions, broker\-dealers, foreign banking organizations, asset management firms with significant capital markets activities. Project teams frequently work with the senior management of these firms, including CFOs and CROs.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The role is for a Basel III Business Analyst supporting the Basel III Proposal Roadmap implementation. The engagement focuses on restarting Basel III Proposal implementation program, adopting the Expanded Risk\-Based Approach (ERBA), accelerating Single Counterparty Credit Limits (SCCL) gross exposure measurements, and onboarding incremental Basel III data requirements into the Unified Consumption Layer (UCL) Data Factory. The candidate will support exposure\-pod based execution across credit risk, securitization, credit risk mitigation, derivatives / SA\-CCR, operational risk, and related regulatory capital workstreams. The role requires strong business analysis, regulatory capital, data sourcing, data profiling, source\-to\-target mapping, calculation logic documentation, Axiom input mapping, controls design, testing, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities. The candidate will work closely with Risk, Finance, Technology, Data, Operations, and business stakeholders to produce implementation\-ready requirements, support interim ERBA calculator development, and enable transparent program execution through high\-quality documentation, testing, and governance routines.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support detailed implementation planning, governance, project management, status reporting, RAID / action trackers, decision logs, and senior stakeholder updates for the B3P Roadmap.
* Refresh the Basel III Proposal / ERBA gap assessment and identify new, modified, or enhanced data elements required for rule interpretation, regulatory capital calculations, and downstream reporting.
* Perform data profiling and fit\-for\-use analysis across existing UCL data elements and source\-system data, including review of missing values, syntax consistency, data completeness, appropriateness for regulatory requirements, and data quality issues.
* Document data sourcing, transformation, derivation, and calculation logic requirements for ERBA exposure types including residential mortgage / MSR, CRE, retail, off\-balance sheet, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, derivatives / SA\-CCR, and operational risk.
* Develop source\-to\-target mappings, business data dictionaries, data lineage, and transformation specifications to support onboarding of incremental Basel III data requirements into the UCL Data Factory.
* Support UCL Data Factory activities, including data movement logic, UCL data model design, legacy consumption views, UCL ADRS unification, semantic layer configuration inputs, and source\-to\-target reconciliation / data validation activities.
* Map data elements to Axiom\-required calculation inputs and document the business rules, derivations, assumptions, controls, and evidence required to support regulatory capital proces…

Fox Corporation
Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.**JOB DESCRIPTION**

### **Fox Corporation:****Fox Corporation is home to industry\-leading brands including FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations, and Tubi Media Group. We combine innovative technology, deep data insights, and world\-class content to shape the future of digital entertainment. Our DTC platforms are built to deliver highly personalized, scalable user experiences to millions of global users.**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


FOX Corporation is looking for a highly skilled and experienced **SDE (L2\) / Senior Engineer (tvOS)** for its Digital Product Engineering tvOS team. The candidate should have a strong working knowledge of Object\-Oriented Programming principles and native Apple TV application development using Swift and the tvOS SDK.


Our tvOS team is responsible for developing and maintaining high\-performance streaming applications that bring FOX's premium content to millions of users on Apple TV devices worldwide. We leverage modern Apple technologies and engineering best practices to deliver intuitive, reliable, and engaging viewing experiences. With a strong emphasis on application performance, scalability, code quality, and user experience, the team is committed to building products that meet the highest standards of quality and reliability.


As an SDE (L2\) / Senior Engineer (tvOS), you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and maintaining native Apple TV applications. You will contribute to technical initiatives, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality, scalable, and user\-centric streaming experiences.

**A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, develop, and maintain advanced native applications for the tvOS platform using Swift.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, UX Designers, Backend Engineers, and QA teams to define, design, and deliver new platform features.
* Build high\-quality, scalable, and maintainable applications that provide exceptional streaming experiences.
* Ensure the performance, quality, responsiveness, and reliability of tvOS applications.
* Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, authentication services, analytics platforms, and backend systems.
* Optimize application startup time, navigation, memory usage, and video playback performance.
* Identify application bottlenecks, troubleshoot production issues, and implement effective solutions.
* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions.
* Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
* Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested, and documented code following engineering best practices.
* Continuously evaluate and implement modern Apple technologies to improve development efficiency and application quality.
* Mentor junior engineers and actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the engineering team.
* Support production releases and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve customer\-impacting issues.

**WHAT YOU WILL NEED**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3–7 years of professional experience in native iOS/tvOS application development.
* Strong proficiency in**Swift, and Apple frameworks****.**
* Hands\-on experience with **tvOS SDK****,** **UIKit****,** **SwiftUI****,** and Apple's development ecosystem, including the tvOS focus engine
* Experience integrating RESTful APIs and backend services.
* Strong understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming, design patterns, and application architecture.
* Experience working with Git, code review practices, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with Xcode Instrumentation tools for profiling CPU, memory, and rendering performance etc..
* Solid grasp of Protocol\-Oriented Programming and swift protocols/extensions.
* Strong understanding of application performance tuning, memory optimization, and debugging techniques.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. Capital Projects Benchmarking Analyst will support Chevron’s ENGINE group by compiling, validating, and analyzing benchmarking data across the upstream business to enable business decisions, including competitive goals setting. At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI\-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We work in tight, skilled teams, prioritize clarity over complexity, and continuously evolve through curiosity, data, and craftsmanship. We’re seeking technologists and problem solvers who thrive in fast\-paced environments, love collaborating with great talent, and approach every day like it’s Day 1\.
   

  

 We're a globally diverse team with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India. If you're driven by continuous learning, rapid pivots, and the challenges of building in a high\-growth startup, we’d love to talk. This is more than a job—it’s a journey.
   

  

 You will own the surface where humans and AI work together to serve customers — the messaging platform, the Virtual Agent and the channels it runs on, and the AI Services that make every human agent faster and every automated conversation better. This is one of the largest product surfaces at ASAPP, and it is where the promise of AI\-native customer experience is proven or lost.
   

  

 You will set and execute the strategy for a product surface that spans the Messaging Platform, Virtual Agent, the messaging and voice channels (Web, iOS, Android, Apple Messages for Business, RCS etc), and the AI Services that sit underneath them — AI\-assisted human augmentation tools. You will become the go\-to expert on this domain, internally and externally, and will be the PM voice in conversations with customers, account teams, and executive stakeholders.
   

  

 The scope will evolve as our AI architecture evolves — as automation absorbs more of the conversation and the line between human and AI work keeps moving. The strongest candidates will be comfortable shaping a moving target, and will bring the technical and customer depth to anticipate what the right target is as AI develops in the space.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 You will own a set of interconnected product areas and be accountable for their strategy, roadmap, and outcomes. Below is what that looks like concretely.
   

  

* Own the Messaging Platform — the application where live agents handle concurrent conversations, access customer context and knowledge, and collaborate with AI. Own the roadmap for agent productivity and the human side of every AI\-assisted interaction.

* Own the external documentation for this surface as part of the product. Drive a docs\-first approach where documentation ships with features, not after them.


**Across All Of These Areas**
* Set strategy and own the roadmap — balancing active customer commitments, tech debt, and platform bets.
* Work directly with customers and account teams to prioritize and sequence delivery.
* Maintain ruthless prioritization: actively manage customer asks with product evolution bets; say no with clarity and evidence.
* Establish metrics and telemetry for each product area so outcomes are measurable and decisions are data\-driven. You can answer “why?” for everything on your roadmap.


**Who You Are**
* Rapid, Practical Learning: You can drop into an unfamiliar domain and get to working expertise fast, teaching yourself what you need rather than waiting to be onboarded. You pair that with a practical approach to innovation — you know the difference between a novel idea and a useful one, and you ship the version that moves the business rather than the version that is merely clever.
* Extreme Ownership: You take responsibility to deliver. You do not wait to be asked — you identify the gap and close it. You are the final owner; the outcome is yours.
* High\-Velocity Outcomes: You measure yourself by outcomes, not output. You distinguish between shipping a feature and moving a metric. You can answer “what changed for the customer?” for everything on your roadmap.
* Effective Communication, Collaboration, and Trust: You influence without authority across engineering, design, sales, and customer success. You overcommunicate to keep stakeholders aligned. You know when to drive consensus and when to make a call. You are highly organized to keep everyone aligned.
* Real\-Time Feedback: You give and receive feedback continuously. You do not save it for quarterly reviews. When something is wrong, you say so directly and constructively.


**What You Will Need**
* 5\+ years of product management experience ideally in enterprise B2B SaaS and/or native AI platforms.
* Technical depth to engage credibly with engineers on model behavior, conversation design, channel architecture, and AI/ML tradeoffs — you can reason about accuracy, latency, and trust requirements, not just consume them.
* Demonstrated ability to own a complex, multi\-surface product area with minimal oversight.

**About Us**
**Phyllo** 
 is a data gateway that allows social data to be accessed from source platforms (e.g. YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Upwork, Shopify, and more). We build the underlying infrastructure that connects with every creator platform, maintain a live data feed to the systems used by these platforms to manage creators’ data, and provide a normalized data set so that businesses can use creators’ data in a simple yet impactful way.
   

  

**Clayface** 
 is our AI analyst for consumer brands, built on top of that data foundation. Insights and brand teams at consumer goods companies spend days pulling numbers together from retail, social, and syndicated sources before they can start analysing anything. Clayface does that work for them. You ask it a business question and it comes back with an answer: what changed, what is likely driving it, and what to look at next, with the source behind every number.
   

  

**More Info At**
* Clayface: https://www.clayface.ai/
* Phyllo: https://www.getphyllo.com/
* Our Crunchbase profile: https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/phyllo


**About The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Product Manager to lead Clayface.** 
 You will own what the analyst can do, how it arrives at an answer, and how much a brand team can trust what comes back. That means understanding the questions insights and category teams actually ask, designing the steps the product takes to answer them, and making sure those answers hold up when someone senior pushes back in a meeting.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role. You will be close to the product every day: trying things yourself, reading what it produced, and deciding what to change. It is not an AI strategy role, and it is not a role where you write a brief and wait for engineering to come back with something.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
**Consumer brand insights**
* The roadmap for Clayface: which business questions we answer well next, which types of analysis we take on, and what we deliberately leave out.
* Spending real time with insights, brand, and category teams at consumer goods companies. You need to understand how decisions actually get made, what gets asked in the room, and where teams currently get stuck.
* Turning that understanding into a product that gives useful answers rather than impressive\-looking output. An analysis that is technically correct but does not help someone decide anything is a failure.
* Writing clear requirements an engineer can build from without needing a second meeting.


**An orchestrated platform for real\-world use cases**
* Clayface is not a single prompt. It is a sequence of steps: find the right data, match it across sources, run the analysis, check the result, and explain it clearly. You will design how those steps fit together, which ones the system decides for itself, and where a person should stay in the loop.
* Making the product work across the messy range of questions real customers ask, not just the handful that demo well. That includes deciding what should happen when the data is thin, when two sources disagree, or when the honest answer is that we cannot tell yet.
* Working with engineering on what the platform needs so we can add new data sources, categories, and customers without rebuilding it each time.
* Balancing quality against speed and cost. How long an answer takes and what it costs us to produce are product decisions, not just engineering ones.


**Quality and Trust**
* Deciding what a good answer looks like for each kind of question, and making sure we measure it rather than assume it. You will set the bar and work with engineering on how it gets checked. The specific methods will change as the product grows, and we expect you to have opinions on that.
* Making sure every number can be traced back to a source and a time period. Customers make expensive decisions on this output, and a confident wrong answer costs us far more than no answer.
* Testing properly before things go live. AI products fail quietly rather than loudly, so a few good examples is never enough evidence to ship.
* Owning the questions enterprise buyers ask about data handling, security, and how their data is used.


**Working with the team**

* Connecting the product to outcomes that matter to the business: customers who keep using it, accounts that grow, and deals that close faster.

* A working understanding of how AI products are put together today: how a model gets the context it needs, how it uses tools and data sources, how multi\-step workflows are strung together, and where these systems usually break.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
 WisdomAI builds AI\-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
   

  

 We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
   

  

**About WisdomAI**
 WisdomAI is on a mission to make working with data delightful. We empower businesses to unlock insights, drive innovation, and make data\-driven decisions at scale. Join our rapidly growing team and be a part of a company that is shaping the future of enterprise data. We are a fast\-paced, early\-stage startup, currently \~30 people and growing.
   

  

**The Role: A Builder, An Empath, and An Executor**
 This is not a traditional Product Manager position; it is a dynamic, hands\-on function built for the age of AI\-native product development. We are a build\-first company that values execution and rapid iteration over lengthy documentation.
   

  

 At WisdomAI, the Product Manager acts as a catalyst for collective intelligence, empowering engineers and designers to propose and build, keenly capture customer feedback, and continuously strive for improvement. This role requires a minimum of 4\+ years of relevant experience and a deep balance of technical understanding and customer empathy.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
 The PM role serves as the glue that connects the customer's needs, the market's demands, and our team's creative and technical capabilities.
   

  

* Customer Empathy and Data Mastery
* Cultivate deep customer empathy by spending time with prospects and users, observing workflows, and understanding their business context.
* Translate customer pain points into clear and actionable problem statements for the development team.
* Leverage your technical and data understanding to evaluate product performance, interpret complex analytics, and inform strategic decisions.
* Proactively track qualitative and quantitative feedback by monitoring support channels, listening to sales calls, and checking in with customer\-facing teams.
* Technical Depth and Execution Orientation
* Guide the team in choosing the right development approach for the task at hand (PM\-first, Design\-first, or Dev\-first), relying on your technical understanding of our platform.
* Define the problem and its constraints, allowing engineers to write robust solution proposals.
* Maintain a relentless execution oriented focus, seeing yourself as an extension of the development team, unblocking them and consistently following through on commitments to drive features to launch.
* Work effectively in our fast\-paced environment, balancing immediate user needs with long\-term strategic goals.
* Strategic Communication
* Facilitate discussions, lead brainstorms, and articulate a compelling product vision to align the entire organization.
* Act as a product evangelist, collaborating with sales, marketing, and customer success to clearly articulate the product’s value.
* Proactively close the feedback loop, ensuring insights from users and the market are constantly flowing back into the development process.


**What You'll Bring: Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience in Product Management, specifically within B2B SaaS, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related AI\-native platforms.
* Proven track record of successful product delivery and strategic execution in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated technical and data understanding—you must be comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, model performance, and architectural trade\-offs with customers and engineers.
* Deeply rooted customer empathy and proficiency in interpreting user analytics and business metrics to guide product strategy.
* Strong collaborative and stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Our CRAFT**
 CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
   

  

**C — Customer trust.** 
 Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
   

  

**R — Relentless on outcomes.** 
 We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
   

  

**A — Authenticity.** 
 We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
   

  

**F — First principles, grounded in reality.** 
 We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real\-world results decide.
   

  

**T — Transparency.** 
 We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
   

  

**Equal opportunity employer**
 WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

 Product Manager IGT\-S

**uct Manager IGT\-S**
 As Product Manager, you will support product planning, development, and lifecycle management activities while applying strong AI expertise to enhance customer insight generation, requirements development, data\-driven decision\-making, and product management practices. You will work in a global, multidisciplinary environment within Philips Healthcare, helping to deliver innovative solutions that create value for customers and patients.
   

  

**Your Role**
 As Product Manager, you will work closely with cross\-functional teams to translate customer, market, and business needs into product requirements and roadmap recommendations. A strong background in Artificial Intelligence is essential, as you will be expected to leverage AI technologies and AI\-driven approaches to improve product management effectiveness, uncover actionable insights, streamline decision\-making, and drive innovation across all phases of product development and lifecycle management.
   

  

* Support product roadmap development, business case creation, and PDLM planning activities using customer, market, and data\-driven insights, including AI\-enabled analysis tools.

 Image Guided Therapy Systems (IGT\-S) is a global leader in image\-guided solutions that enable minimally invasive diagnosis and treatment across multiple clinical domains. The IGT\-S organization is responsible for the global marketing, development, and manufacturing of innovative systems, software, and services that help clinicians perform complex procedures with greater precision, efficiency, and confidence.
   

  

 You will be part of the Product Management team, working closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate customer, clinical, and business needs into successful products and solutions. The team is responsible for driving product innovation, supporting new product development, and managing products throughout their lifecycle.
   

  

 As part of Philips Healthcare, you will contribute to meaningful innovations that improve patient outcomes and enhance the experience of both clinicians and patients. This position is based in Bangalore and reports to the Director of Product Management.

* 8\+ years of experience in Product Management, Marketing, Strategy, or related leadership roles in a technology\-driven environment.

* Strong background in Artificial Intelligence, including practical experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI\-assisted product development, and AI\-driven business processes.

 We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Position: Solutions Engineer


Location: Bangalore


Working Days: Monday to Friday


Experience Required: 1\-3 years


**Role Overview**
-----------------


As a Solutions Engineer, you will be the primary technical partner for our customers. You will lead onboarding, guide teams through the client's SDK integrations, configure attribution and deep linking, work hands\-on in ad network dashboards, and provide day\-to\-day technical customer support.


Communication and problem solving are the two most important capabilities for this role. Customers may report that tracking is broken, an install is showing as organic, a deep link is opening the wrong destination, or events are missing. You will gather the right context, inspect the integration and data, isolate the cause, explain it clearly, and own the issue through a verified resolution.


**What You Will Do**
--------------------


### **1\. Customer Onboarding and Solution Design**


* Lead technical kick\-off calls with customer engineering, product, and growth teams.
* Understand the customer's app architecture, platforms, attribution goals, events, user journeys, and campaign launch plan.
* Create a practical integration checklist, define owners, and track the customer from initial setup through production validation.
* Set expectations clearly, identify blockers early, and keep technical and non\-technical stakeholders aligned.

### **2\. SDK Integration and Validation**


* Guide customers through integrating SDKs for Android, iOS, Flutter, React Native, Expo, and Web.
* Help install and configure packages through Maven Central, CocoaPods or Swift Package Manager, pub.dev, and npm.
* Support SDK initialization, project token setup, app and bundle identifiers, platform permissions, manifest or plist changes, and environment configuration.
* Review customer implementation code for app lifecycle handling, deferred deep links, Universal Links, Android App Links, custom URI schemes, and deep link callbacks.
* Help implement and validate customer user IDs, app opens, custom events, onboarding events, revenue or payment events, and other required event payloads.
* Verify event names, required parameters, data types, timestamps, and identity consistency so data reaches in the expected format.
* Validate integration behavior on fresh installs, reinstalls, app updates, background and foreground launches, and common in\-app browser journeys.
* Check SDK and wrapper version compatibility, reproduce issues using sample apps, and confirm whether a problem exists in the customer's installed package or the latest published version.
* Run staging and production\-readiness checks before launch, then verify clicks, installs, deep links, events, attribution, and postbacks end to end.

### **3\. Ad Network Setup and Troubleshooting**


* Work directly inside customer dashboards such as Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads, with exposure to Apple Search Ads, TikTok Ads, and Snap Ads.
* Configure and verify destination URLs, tracking templates, custom parameters, dynamic macros, conversion actions, attribution windows, and account permissions.
* Check that network click identifiers and campaign parameters flow correctly into and are not missing, malformed, or left unsubstituted.
* Set up and validate server\-to\-server postbacks, Meta App Events, Google Ads conversions, Play Install Referrer flows, and SKAdNetwork\-related configuration.
* Compare network dashboard metrics with data and explain expected differences in attribution windows, reporting delays, and measurement methods.

### **4\. Technical Troubleshooting and Root\-Cause Analysis**


* Diagnose issues across SDK code, mobile app configuration, tracking links, redirects, campaign settings, domains, DNS or CDN behavior, and ad network configuration.
* Troubleshoot Universal Links, Android App Links, deferred deep linking, custom schemes, and webview behavior across WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, and other in\-app browsers.
* Use cURL, REST APIs, JSON payloads, device logs, browser developer tools, Charles Proxy or Proxyman, and basic SQL queries to collect evidence.
* Distinguish between an SDK bug, customer implementation issue, campaign configuration problem, ad network setup issue, test\-device behavior, and a platform incident.
* Reproduce issues, document the evidence, work with engineering when a code change is required, and verify the fix before closing the issue.

### **5\. Customer Communication and Support**


* Serve as a frontline responder across shared Slack channels, WhatsApp groups, calls, and support queues.
* Ask focused questions and turn vague reports into clear, testable problem statements.
* Explain technical findings in plain language to growth and business teams, while giving customer engineers the implementation detail they need.
* Provide timely status updates, set realistic expectations, and communicate clear owners and next steps during active investigations.
* Stay calm during campaign launches or escalations and take ownership until the customer has a verified resolution.

### **6\. Documentation and Product Feedback**


* Write and maintain integration guides, setup checklists, code examples, FAQs, and troubleshooting playbooks.
* Record common failure patterns and turn repeated support questions into better documentation, SDK safeguards, or product improvements.
* Share structured customer feedback with product and engineering teams and help prioritize issues based on customer impact.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------


### **1\. Problem Solving**


* A methodical approach to debugging. You collect evidence, form hypotheses, test them, and avoid guessing.
* Comfort working through incomplete information and knowing which questions, logs, dashboards, or tests will narrow the issue.
* Strong ownership and persistence. You follow technical blockers through to a verified resolution.
